primary: Equal-case-weight full-minus-basic error-risk difference conditional on the frozen twelve held-out tasks
primaryInference: Participant-cluster leave-one-out jackknife SE and t(N-1) two-sided test/95% interval
supportingModel: Conditional logistic mixed-model odds ratio with fixed case effects

recruitment.targetDefinition: Participants with all four retained observed records in both primary conditions
recruitment.replacementRule: Whole blocks after current dispositions close; target or fixed cap determines stopping using availability only

withdrawal.delete: Exclude and purge named response/rating/key records and reanalyze retained observations
withdrawal.retainPartial: Analyze only authorized observed rows and disclose scheduled-versus-observed availability
withdrawal.unknownLoss: Record administrative missingness reason; no imputed outcome rows
